data.name: Qualial Nature
data.detailed_description:
Listening to Nature's Voice: A Quiet Adventure

A Healing Exploration Adventure Through Forest and Soul

Qualial Nature is

a gentle exploration experience connecting with nature and purifying the forest.

Players visit the forest and encounter Anima (souls) of land, sea, and sky.

With the Anima's power, solve nature's troubles one by one,

gradually guiding the forest back to its true form.

No fighting. No rushing.

Simply listen to the voice of nature.

――――――――――

【Story】

※Space for story content here

(Example: Why the protagonist came to the forest / How they encounter the Anima, etc.)

――――――――――

＜Game Features＞

◆ Encountering Anima and the Power of Purification

Explore the forest, sea, and treetops to find Anima.

Each Anima possesses the power to heal nature.

By utilizing each Anima's unique traits, you can explore the forest more comfortably and freely.

◆ Communicate with Nature Through Anima

Acquiring Anima allows players to hear nature's voice.

Successful purification may prompt the forest, water, or wind to respond with “thank you.”

You won't be told where impurities lie—it's crucial to seek them out, notice them, and act with your own feet.

It feels like conversing with nature not through words, but through your heart.

◆ Free-Roaming, Nonlinear Exploration

There is no set order.

Visit places that catch your interest freely and proceed with purification at your own pace.

◆ A Gentle Game Experience Without Combat

This game contains no battles.

It is a game that values quiet time spent connecting with nature.

◆ The Forest Landscape Gradually Transforms

As purification progresses, the forest regains its original beauty.

Witnessing this change is one of the game's greatest charms.

data.short_description: 『Qualial Nature』 is a gentle exploration experience where you purify the forest while connecting with nature. Players visit the forest and encounter Anima of land, sea, and sky. Borrowing the power of the Anima, solve nature's troubles one by one and gradually guide the forest back to its true form.
